title: A small collaboration proposal to DEE-P Connections

sentences.text: UNC13A and SNAP25 help nerve cells prepare to release messages, offering a starting point for sharing knowledge.
The atlas infers DEEP’s SNAP25 connection from a website link, not formal membership; confidence is 0.45, below 0.5.

sections.heading: What already exists that we could share

sentences.text: Congenital Muscle Disease International Registry (CMDIR) includes UNC13A families; RARE-X and Simons Searchlight include SNAP25 families.
Citizen Health, ENDD Center, ESCO and the STXBP1 Foundation Grants Program are further STXBP1 resources to explore, not confirmed UNC13A opportunities.

sections.heading: What must be checked before we join forces

sentences.text: Confirm related-condition eligibility for every proposed shared resource, including CMDIR; Simons Searchlight’s SNAP25/VAMP2 coverage comes from its website rather than the ClinicalTrials.gov condition list.
Compare missing symptom fields: EEG central sharp waves, axonal spheroids and 20 more for SNAP25 resources, versus 13 more for STXBP1 resources.

Check differing mechanisms: altered protein blocking normal protein in both groups, calcium-triggered message release plus one unspecified mechanism for SNAP25, and protein instability/misfolding plus three unspecified mechanisms for STXBP1.
Ask whether central sharp waves, axonal spheroids and intrahepatic inclusion bodies occur in neighboring conditions, especially STX1B.
Read both sides of the contested STX1B loss-of-function evidence; UNC13A gain-of-function and SNAP25 loss-of-function interpretations are also contested.
Check for UNC13A and STX1B family groups, consider a family network, and seek clinic or researcher introductions before outreach.
Let us jointly draft one CMDIR information note for STX1B families, for clinic-mediated sharing after eligibility checks, without promising enrollment.
Is there a dedicated UNC13A patient organization?
Is any interventional trial enrolling people with UNC13A-related disorders?
Is there a documented, accessible UNC13A animal or cell model in the atlas?
Which individual variants increase protein activity, impair its activity, or cause loss of function?
Dear DEE-P Connections team,
Could we explore a modest collaboration?
CMDIR already includes UNC13A families.
We propose drafting an eligibility-checked information note for STX1B families this month.
Would you help us shape it and explore clinic introductions?
[Your name], on behalf of families affected by UNC13A-related disorders
